newsitem.title: USA: Paging stocks get a boost from Motorola meeting.
newsitem.headline: Paging stocks get a boost from Motorola meeting.

text.p: Paging stocks got a boost on Friday after Motorola Inc offered a bullish outlook on the business in a briefing for Wall Street analysts.

"Motorola went to great lengths to say the (paging) business is a growth business. People probably came away encouraged from the Motorola meeting," said Lior Bregman, an analyst at Oppenheimer & Co Inc. Motorola met with analysts on Thursday.
Among the wireless communication companies, shares of Glenayre Technologies Inc rose 7/8 to close at 24-1/8 and Mobile Telecom gained 1-1/8 to close at 11-3/4.
Nextel Communications Inc shares gained 5/16 to close at 15-1/16. Paging Network Inc shares closed unchanged from Thursday's close of 15-3/4.

Jeffrey Hines, a NatWest Securities analyst, said in a report the conference "did nothing to dampen our enthusiasm toward iDEN and FLEX," two of Motorola's network technologies on which certain paging and wireless companies rely.
He said the upbeat outlook from Motorola should benefit both Nextel and PageNet in particular.
iDen is Motorola's wireless digital system and InFLEXion is its voice messaging protocol.
